svg.title: Agentic Digital Twin — merged decision flow with data sources and communication layer
svg.desc: Full decision flow: data sources → digital twin agent → prediction → risk diamond → context agent → decision agent → confidence agent → autonomy diamond → human-in-the-loop gate → communication and control agent → action execution. Recovery loop returns to digital twin.
svg.text: Risk score + fault context → optimal action
Assess risk × certainty × impact → autonomy level
Action execution — continue / reduce / maintain / stop / increase speed (recovery)
